name: Knee Arthrocentesis
summary: Knee Arthrocentesis is a hands-on VR simulation designed to train healthcare learners in performing knee joint aspiration safely and effectively. Users are guided through patient assessment, consent, positioning, anatomical landmark identification, sterile preparation, needle insertion, synovial fluid aspiration, and post-procedure management.
